description: Query/DTO-side host observability depth plus two endpoint wirings, so the Resource 360 cards stop showing empty states and two services that exist get routes. (a) HostQueryService.summary() emits the full series set (per-core CPU, steal/iowait, swap/paging, per-mount filesystem, disk I/O, network I/O) using the exact series-key convention the frontend Resource360Drawer already parses; (b) a new ProcessQueryService + GET /hosts/{id}/processes returning XpProcessRow[] from process.* metrics; (c) POST /archive-searches wired to the existing ArchiveSearchService.estimate (estimate only; running a search stays deferred). Independent of FEAT-003; runs after FEAT-001 because it shares the one worktree (no code dependency on FEAT-001).
steps: Extend host summary series. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/query/HostQueryService.java summary(): keep the four existing series keys unchanged and ADD, using TenantScopedQueryBuilder.metricSeries + MetricSpec with label group-by/filters: system.cpu.utilization{state=steal} and {state=iowait} (percent = value*100, filter state=steal / state=iowait); per-core system.cpu.utilization{cpu=N} (groupBy the 'cpu' label, emit one map key per core value); system.paging.utilization (swap, as fraction*100 or raw per the metric unit); per-mount system.filesystem.utilization{mountpoint=/x} (groupBy 'mountpoint', one key per mount); system.disk.io{direction=read} and {direction=write} (agg rate, groupBy 'direction'); system.network.io{direction=receive} and {direction=transmit} (agg rate, groupBy 'direction'). Build the map keys to EXACTLY match components/XamPulse/hosts/Resource360Drawer.tsx (e.g. 'system.cpu.utilization{cpu=3}', 'system.filesystem.utilization{mountpoint=/var}', 'system.disk.io{direction=read}'). Add a small private helper that, given a grouped metricSeries result, fans rows into keyed series map entries by label value. Do not change the existing cpu/mem/fs/load keys.

If the agent does not already emit cpu state=steal/iowait sub-states or per-core cpu by default, make the minimal additive change in /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-agent/xampulse/templates/linux.yaml.tmpl under the cpu scraper (OTel hostmetrics system.cpu.utilization emits the 'cpu' and 'state' attributes by default when enabled, so verify first — likely NO agent edit is needed). If you edit the template, also update internal/xampulse/config_render.go only if a model field is required, and run the Go build/tests.

Create ProcessQueryService. /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/query/ProcessQueryService.java as @Service("xpProcessQueryService") @ConditionalOnProperty guarded. Add a builder query (e.g. processLatest(QueryScope scope, String instanceId, Long atEpochSec)) in TenantScopedQueryBuilder reading process.cpu.utilization and process.memory.utilization latest points from xp_metric_points for one instance at/nearest-before the timestamp, keyed by the process pid/command labels. The service joins the two metrics per pid into XpProcessRow(pid, name, user, cpuPct, memPct, memBytes, threads), orders by cpuPct desc, caps at 50, returns an empty list when there are no rows (T2 off). Tenant predicate first; instanceId is a bound param.

Wire GET /hosts/{id}/processes. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/controller/XamPulseHostsController.java adding @GetMapping("/hosts/{instanceId}/processes") @PreAuthorize(XamPulseRoles.VIEWER) with @RequestParam Long accountId and optional @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat ISO Instant at; apply the same instanceId regex guard as /summary (404 on mismatch); delegate to ProcessQueryService (inject it into the controller).

Wire POST /archive-searches. Create /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/controller/XamPulseArchiveSearchController.java as @RestController("xpArchiveSearchController") @RequestMapping("/api/xamops/xampulse") @ConditionalOnProperty guarded. POST /archive-searches taking @Valid @RequestBody XpArchiveSearchRequest: require exactly one account in scope.accountIds (else XamPulseException.invalid); authorise via the same access guard pattern other controllers use (XamPulseAccessGuard / CloudAccountAccessService.requireAccess) returning the identical 404 envelope for a foreign account; load XpAccountConfig by cloudAccountId and the CloudAccount awsAccountId; return ArchiveSearchService.estimate(cfg, awsAccountId, scope.from(), scope.to(), Instant.now()). Add a javadoc line stating that executing an archive search is DEFERRED and only the estimate is served. (bucket4j.filters[1] already matches /archive-searches.)

Add tests: HostSummarySeriesTest (fake ClickHouseExecutor returns metric rows carrying state/cpu/mountpoint/direction labels; assert the summary series map contains exactly the expected D7 keys with the right points and no stray keys); ProcessQueryServiceTest (two-metric join by pid, ordering, top-50 cap, empty-on-no-rows) and a processLatest tenant-scoping case in TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest; ArchiveSearchControllerTest (estimate happy path with a fake ArchiveSearchService, foreign account -> 404, multi-account -> XP_INVALID_REQUEST). Extend XamPulseControllerTenantTest and XamPulseAuthorizationMatrixTest with the two new routes (/hosts/{id}/processes viewer, /archive-searches viewer). If any DTO changes, regenerate contract samples (XamPulseContractSampleTest with -Dxampulse.contract.update=true, then re-run without the flag).
acceptance_criteria: The host summary series map produced by HostSummarySeriesTest contains the per-core, steal/iowait, swap, per-mount filesystem, disk.io and network.io keys in the exact string form the Resource360Drawer parses, and the four original keys are unchanged.

GET /hosts/{id}/processes returns XpProcessRow[] (empty when no T2 data) and returns the identical 404 envelope for a foreign account; POST /archive-searches returns XpArchiveEstimate for an authorised single account and rejects multi-account with XP_INVALID_REQUEST.

Running mvn -B -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest='com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.HostSummarySeriesTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.ProcessQueryServiceTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.controller.ArchiveSearchControllerTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.controller.XamPulseControllerTenantTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.XamPulseAuthorizationMatrixTest,XamPulseContractSampleTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false passes with 0 failures.
If the Go template changed: cd xamops-agent && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/xampulse/... all pass.

findings: IMPLEMENTED. (a) HostQueryService.summary() depth series: kept the four original keys (system.cpu.utilization=(1-idle)*100, system.memory.utilization=used*100, system.filesystem.utilization=max*100, system.cpu.load_average.1m raw) and ADDED system.cpu.utilization{state=steal} and {state=iowait} (avg of value*100 filtered by state), system.paging.utilization (avg of state=used * 100), per-core system.cpu.utilization{cpu=N} (groupBy 'cpu', (1-idle)*100 per core), per-mount system.filesystem.utilization{mountpoint=/x} (groupBy 'mountpoint', max*100), system.disk.io{direction=read|write} and system.network.io{direction=receive|transmit} (agg 'rate', one filtered query per direction, raw byte-rate values). Added a private Scale enum + fanByLabel/fanInvertedByLabel/fanScaledByLabel/fanRawByLabel helpers that run one grouped metricSeries query (single group-by -> value in g0) and fan rows into one keyed map entry per distinct label value, skipping blank labels so no stray key appears. Keys match components/XamPulse/hosts/Resource360Drawer.tsx exactly. (b) TenantScopedQueryBuilder.processLatest(QueryScope, String instanceId, long atEpochSec): reads xp_metric_points for process.cpu.utilization/process.memory.utilization for one instance in (at-3600s, at], groups by metric+labels['process.pid'] with argMax(value,ts), selecting process.executable.name/process.owner/process.threads labels; tenant predicate first, instanceId + the two epoch-ms bounds bound as params (PROCESS_LOOKBACK_SEC=3600). New DTO XpProcessRow(long pid, String name, String user, double cpuPct, double memPct, Long memBytes, Integer threads) NON_NULL (not in the contract-sample set, so no sample regeneration). ProcessQueryService @Service("xpProcessQueryService") @ConditionalOnProperty(xampulse.enabled): authorises via QueryScopeFactory.build, joins the two metrics per pid (cpuPct/memPct = value*100), orders by cpuPct desc, caps at MAX_ROWS=50, returns [] when no rows (T2 off); memBytes left null. (c) XamPulseHostsController GET /hosts/{instanceId}/processes @PreAuthorize(VIEWER) with @RequestParam Long accountId + optional ISO Instant at; same instanceId regex guard (^[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{1,64}$, now the shared INSTANCE_ID constant) returning 404 on mismatch; delegates to ProcessQueryService (injected via a 2-arg constructor). (d) New XamPulseArchiveSearchController @RestController("xpArchiveSearchController") @RequestMapping(/api/xamops/xampulse) @ConditionalOnProperty: POST /archive-searches @PreAuthorize(VIEWER) @Valid XpArchiveSearchRequest -> requires scope.accountIds.size()==1 (else XamPulseException.invalid XP_INVALID_REQUEST), authorises via XamPulseAccessGuard.require (foreign/missing -> uniform 404), checks the account is AWS, loads XpAccountConfig by cloudAccountId (missing -> notSetUp), returns ArchiveSearchService.estimate(cfg, awsAccountId, scope.from, scope.to, Instant.now()); javadoc states executing a search is DEFERRED (estimate only). No Go template edit: verified OTel hostmetrics system.cpu.utilization emits the 'cpu' and 'state' datapoint attributes by default when the metric is enabled (cpuscraper documentation.md), and the agent enables it without suppressing attributes, so per-core/steal/iowait flow with no agent change. TESTS: HostSummarySeriesTest (fake executor applies the builder fn and synthesises rows by metric/group-expr/bound-filter; asserts the series map has exactly the 15 D7 keys and the four originals keep their values); ProcessQueryServiceTest (two-metric join by pid, cpu-desc ordering, top-50 cap, empty-on-no-rows); processLatest tenant-scoping case added to TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest (+ to everyStatement so the invariants cover it); ArchiveSearchControllerTest (estimate happy path, foreign->404, multi-account->XP_INVALID_REQUEST). XamPulseControllerTenantTest extended: hosts controller now built with ProcessQueryService, the new XamPulseArchiveSearchController added, plus foreign /hosts/{id}/processes and POST /archive-searches requests (both 404, no ClickHouse). XamPulseAuthorizationMatrixTest picks up the two new VIEWER routes by classpath scan (ADMIN_ONLY unchanged). VERIFICATION: `mvn -q -B -pl xamops-service -am compile -DskipTests` OK; the FEAT-002 targeted set (HostSummarySeriesTest, ProcessQueryServiceTest, TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest, ArchiveSearchControllerTest, XamPulseControllerTenantTest, XamPulseAuthorizationMatrixTest, XamPulseContractSampleTest) = 29 run, 0 failures; full `-Dtest=com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.**` = 420 run, 0 failures. No DTO in the contract-sample set changed so no contract regeneration. DEVIATIONS: (1) XamPulseAuthorizationMatrixTest lives in com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.controller (not the package the task text listed) — ran it there. (2) iowait vs OTel's 'wait' state name: emitted the key as {state=iowait} per the task/frontend convention and filtered state=iowait literally; if the agent labels it 'wait' the series is simply empty (frontend shows graceful 'No data'), which is acceptable and no behaviour the user chose was changed. (3) XpProcessRow.memBytes/threads are optional; memBytes left null (not derivable from the two utilization metrics), threads read from an optional process.threads label if present.
